scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n API,WEB -c cyan,blue "npm run dev -w @agendalab/api" "npm run dev -w @agendalab/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agendalab/api && npm run build -w @agendalab/web
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others -n API,WEB -c cyan,blue "npm run start -w @agendalab/api" "npm run start -w @agendalab/web"
